note: Where cycles run and where every order is sent from. "github": the hourly cycle workflow on GitHub's runners (US data centres; fine for paper, and go-live refuses live orders from there unless explicitly allowed). "alwaysdata": the owner's alwaysdata server in Paris (ops/alwaysdata/). Both sides read this one file, so exactly one of them runs the cycle; flatten and approve become requests the server executes (state/requests/). Switch by editing this line and pushing.
